abm_state_table.name: ABM: what the point carries
abm_state_table.description: The complete printed six-point foraging lesson, permanently in the museum. Hold, move, release and step to see a state change. Replace agents keeps the trace; Clear All erases both.
abm_state_table.qfep_connection: The same body responds differently when it carries food. Replacing individual records need not erase the shared history they inherit.
